verdict_rules.supported: Direction, size and significance agree with the study's planned analysis.
verdict_rules.choices: Not what the planned analysis shows, but what some of the choices qPilot checks give.
verdict_rules.overstated: Says more than the data do: a larger change, a stronger p or a robustness word the study does not earn.
verdict_rules.contradicted: The study says otherwise: the other direction, no change where there is one, or a number its data exclude.
verdict_rules.mismatch: The sentence compares other groups than the study does (for example tumours with an amplified gene, where the study compares high against low expression of it), so the study's numbers do not test it.
verdict_rules.unchecked: The study cannot answer it: a gene it did not compare, or words too vague to check.

text: ODC1 was 3.3-fold higher in the MYCN-high group than in the rest (p < 0.001). NM23A was robustly up-regulated in the MYCN-high group. NTRK1 did not differ between the MYCN-high group and the rest. BIRC5 was 11-fold higher in the MYCN-high group than in the rest. Expression was normalised to GAPDH. All assays had efficiencies of 90–110 %. Expression was normalised to UBC. ODC1 and BIRC5 were up-regulated (4.1- and 6-fold, respectively). n = 53 vs 294 tumours. GAPDH was unchanged. Survivin was 4-fold higher in MYCN-amplified tumours (p < 0.001).
